_: The one source of the countdown. Nothing here is ever shown on screen: only the four two-digit groups (days:hours:minutes:seconds) and their colons. The film is a prerecorded, deterministic animation, not a live clock: its first countdown frame (clockOriginFrame in config/timeline.json) stands for the moment `start`, whatever moment it is watched.
display: ceil: a value is on screen for the whole second that ends at it, so the start shows 03:00:00:00 and one second later 02:23:59:59
